title: Cogni node/service catalog entry (v2)
description: One file = one deploy unit (Argo Application + per-env deploy branches + path_prefix) that owns ≥1 build units (images). See docs/spec/catalog-v2.md and docs/spec/ci-cd.md axiom 16 (CATALOG_IS_SSOT).

schema_version.description: Must be 2. v1 entries are rejected by the loader so the migration is forward-only.

name.description: Deploy unit name. Filename must match name.yaml. Used as Argo Application name suffix and deploy-branch suffix.

type.description: node = full node app; service = supporting service (e.g. scheduler-worker).

node_id.description: UUID v4. Required when type=node. Bound at provision time.

path_prefix.description: Default trigger prefix for owned images. detect-affected.sh uses this when an image has no per-image path_prefix override. Must end with /.

public_url.description: Per-env public URL (Ingress / Caddy) for this deploy unit. Verify scripts (wait-for-candidate-ready.sh, smoke-candidate.sh, verify-buildsha.sh, verify-deployment.sh) read these directly. Optional when the deploy unit has no public ingress.

images.description: Build units owned by this deploy unit. ≥1 entry. Exactly one entry must have role=app (validated by tests/ci-invariants/catalog-v2.spec.ts).

name.description: Image name unique within the repo. Used as map key in build/resolve/promote payloads, in pr-build matrix, and in tests/ci-invariants enforcement.

role.description: app = primary runtime container (exactly one per deploy unit); migrator = initContainer; sidecar = sibling container. Drives overlay-block placement in promote-build-payload.sh.

dockerfile.description: Repo-relative Dockerfile path. Validated to resolve on disk by tests/ci-invariants.

image_name.description: Full GHCR registry path (no tag). Different images may share image_name (suffix discriminates tag namespace) OR live in distinct GHCR repos.

image_tag_suffix.description: Tag suffix appended after the base tag. Empty allowed only when this image is alone in its image_name (no suffix needed to discriminate). The (image_name, image_tag_suffix) tuple is repo-wide unique.

path_prefix.description: Optional per-image override. Default = parent deploy.path_prefix. Must end with /.

build.description: Optional per-image docker buildx config. Absent = default repo-root context, no --target, no smoke test.

context.description: Build context directory. Default: repo root.

target.description: docker buildx --target for the production push.

test_target.description: Optional pre-push smoke target. pr-build runs `docker buildx build --target <test_target>` (no push); failure aborts the leg.

cache_scope.description: GHA cache scope key. Default: build-<image.name>.
